note: It's Thanksgiving weekend in the US, so expect a quieter news day and more box-office and movie-going coverage than usual.

front.title: A closer look at Claude's Mac "apps"
front.tldr: Anthropic's new beta feature turns Claude-built HTML artifacts into apps you can install on Mac and Windows. Federico Viticci dug into how the system actually works under the hood.

front.title: How 'Backrooms' artisans transformed a YouTube series into cinema's favourite liminal space
front.tldr: Kane Parsons' online horror series Backrooms became a $400m global box-office hit, built using 30,000 square feet of practical sets across four sound stages rather than CGI alone.

front.title: Jayson Tatum scores 41, Celtics snap skid with win over Wizards
front.tldr: Tatum had a season-high 41 points, eight assists and six rebounds as Boston beat the Wizards 131-116, avoiding a fifth straight defeat and staying unbeaten in NBA Cup play.

stories.title: Three LLM inflection points in twelve months
stories.tldr: Simon Willison's AI Engineer Code Summit keynote maps three distinct shifts in LLM and coding-agent ability over the past year, a useful shorthand for how fast the ground has moved.

stories.title: Quoting Scott Aaronson
stories.tldr: Computer scientist Scott Aaronson says AI tools are set to reveal not isolated proofs but "a whole new continent of mathematical truth" in complexity theory, quoted by Simon Willison.

stories.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
stories.tldr: OpenAI is combining ChatGPT's Chat and Work tiers under a single usage meter, meaning heavy users could hit their limits sooner once the merge lands.

stories.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
stories.tldr: Amazon and Meta are reportedly discussing a deal to end a two-month-long blockade of Meta's AI agent Muse.

stories.title: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages in group and individual chats
stories.tldr: WhatsApp is rolling out scheduled messages for group and individual chats, letting users queue up a text, photo or video to send from 10 minutes to 14 days ahead.

stories.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
stories.tldr: The FCC approved SpaceX's plan to put AI data centers in orbit, dismissing concerns raised by opponents, including threats to scientific research, as outside its regulatory authority.

stories.title: NASA's DART mission left a stadium-sized crater in an asteroid, the ESA finds
stories.tldr: ESA's Hera probe has begun imaging the aftermath of NASA's deliberate DART impact, confirming it carved a crater the size of a stadium into the asteroid.

stories.title: Nothing's Ear (note) is a pair of earbuds with built-in AI notetaking
stories.tldr: Nothing has teased Ear (note), earbuds with built-in AI notetaking, promising fuller details on 8 December.

stories.title: Apple pulls popular Chinese AI chatbot from the App Store amid child safety concerns
stories.tldr: Apple removed the Chinese AI companion app Talkie from the App Store after reports that its characters sent inappropriate messages to minors.

stories.title: Apple TV's 'Carême' wins top prize at the International Emmys
stories.tldr: Apple TV's period drama Carême won the top award at the International Emmys, after Widow's Bay triumphed at the Emmy Awards earlier this year.

stories.title: Screens can now turn iPhone Duo into a tiny MacBook
stories.tldr: Screens 5.10 adds a playful "tiny laptop mode" for iPhone Duo users, following two other highly requested desktop features added to the app earlier this month.

stories.title: Wispr Flow improves dictation accuracy with new Canto-2 speech-to-text model
stories.tldr: AI dictation app Wispr Flow is rolling out a new Canto-2 speech-to-text model across Mac, iPhone and other platforms, promising fewer errors and better name recognition.

stories.title: 'Baahubali', 'RRR' tech chief C.V. Rao named SMPTE Fellow
stories.tldr: C.V. Rao, who helped shape the production and post-production pipelines behind Baahubali and RRR, has become the first technologist from South India named a SMPTE Fellow.

stories.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' eyes $270M opening as 'Dune: Part Three' also heads for big start
stories.tldr: Avengers: Doomsday is tracking for a $270m opening weekend, with Dune: Part Three also heading for a strong debut as both blockbusters hit early tracking.

stories.title: Cult hit 'Hundreds of Beavers' returns to theaters for big Christmas expansion
stories.tldr: The silent, black-and-white slapstick indie comedy Hundreds of Beavers returns for a third annual holiday re-release, with 130 screenings across 85 cities this Christmas.

stories.title: 'The Mosquito Bowl' producer Alex Gayner thought he'd solved every problem a set could throw at him. Then came a runaway parrot.
stories.tldr: Producer Alex Gayner says the most nerve-wracking ten seconds of The Mosquito Bowl's shoot came from a runaway parrot, not any of the production's bigger logistical problems.

stories.title: Patriots don't want a new Drake Maye. They want Tommy DeVito to be himself.
stories.tldr: With Drake Maye injured, the Patriots have committed to Tommy DeVito as their starting quarterback, telling the 28-year-old simply to be himself.

stories.title: FIA filings reveal the Red Bull aero update behind Max Verstappen's Las Vegas GP win
stories.tldr: FIA filings show a quiet aerodynamic fix underpinned Max Verstappen's Las Vegas Grand Prix win, alongside a high-speed battery deployment battle on track.

stories.title: Five things to look out for at F1's Qatar GP
stories.tldr: F1 heads to Qatar for round 22 of the season this weekend, with both championships already decided and little left to play for.

stories.title: Red Sox had their best bullpen in 2026. Can it be even better in '27?
stories.tldr: Boston's bullpen was its best in 2026, and MLB.com looks at whether an already strong relief corps can improve further heading into next season.

finally.title: Run with the Semi-Wild Yilki Horses of Anatolia in Nur Tucker's Captivating Photos
finally.tldr: In 'The Untold Story of the Yilki Horse', British-Turkish photographer Nur Tucker captures a portrait of the region's free-roaming horses and the living heritage they represent.
